title: Cosmic Wanderer with Robot
description: An elderly man with a beard, wearing a tattered green coat and purple hat, walks along a cracked white pathway using a cane. A small blue robot with a backpack is perched on his shoulders as they traverse a surreal cosmic landscape.
prompt: An elderly bearded man in a worn green overcoat and purple hat walks with a cane along a cracked white pathway that winds through a surreal cosmic landscape. A small blue robot with glowing eyes sits on his shoulders carrying a backpack. The dark background features a glowing galaxy, floating planets, purple crystal plants, red rocky terrain, road signs, and abstract geometric shapes under a starry black sky.
